s0009 dates the edict to 世祖天嘉初; Tianjia began in AD 560, so the early/first year is AD 560, not 562. The proposed parenthetical corrects the Western year without changing the rest of the sentence.

The note contrasts base-text Guangzhao written with zhao 'illumine' (光照殿) against Nanshi/Tongjian Guangzhao with zhao 'manifest' (光昭殿); the proposal rightly sees that identical romanization hides the variant, but English replacements must not insert Chinese graphs. Gloss the homophones in English, as the neighboring note does for ge (sing) vs ge (unit).
